meta: Tour guides plan itineraries, tell stories and answer guests at once. AI can take on part of the prep: itineraries for each group, stories to tell, and translation when needed.

muc.title: A busy tour guide
muc.text: A tour guide plans the itinerary, tells stories and answers every guest question, and AI can take on part of the preparation.

muc.title: Itineraries for each group
muc.text: Tell AI whether the group is older people, families with small kids, or young people who love walking, and ask for an itinerary that suits each group's energy.

muc.title: Prepare your stories
muc.text: Ask AI for ways to tell the place's history in a lively way, but check dates and names in official sources.

muc.title: Translating when needed
muc.text: With guests who speak a less common language, use a voice translation app for basic conversation, but give them the important things in writing.

muc.title: Three opening lines
muc.text: Pick a place you often take guests, ask AI for three fun opening lines for three different groups, then check every fact.
